adds.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
adds.text: After Fury fakes his death, Hill keeps him hidden at a safehouse and brings Steve, Natasha and Sam to him. When they move against HYDRA, she takes control of the helicarriers so they destroy each other.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The boss Hill hides after his faked death.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Hides Fury after his faked death and turns the helicarriers on each other.
adds.evidence: Fury is ambushed on his way to meet Hill; Hill extracts Rogers, Romanoff and Wilson to the safehouse where Fury, who faked his death, plans the chip swap; Rogers replaces the last chip, allowing Hill to take control and have the vessels destroy each other.

adds.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
adds.text: In a HYDRA lab, Dr. List and Strucker keep Pietro as one of two surviving test subjects of their scepter experiments, and List asks what is to be done with the twins.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A test subject List keeps in his HYDRA lab.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA scientist who keeps Pietro as a test subject.
adds.evidence: Mid-credits scene: List and Strucker discuss the twin test subjects given superhuman abilities, shown held in the lab; List asks what to do with the twins.

owner_calls.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
owner_calls.question: The twins appear only as held test subjects in the mid-credits scene, with no exchange of words with List. Keep the proposed earlier boss stages for List here, or leave the ties starting in Avengers: Age of Ultron?
